استرجما (form X)
# اِسْتَرْجَمَا (istarjamā) /is.tar.d͡ʒa.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# اِسْتَرْجِمَا (istarjimā) /is.tar.d͡ʒi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
